about: P32 acceptance set, fixed 2026-09-29 before any genre code (P32-0 T7). 9 open sentences; `sealed` gets 3 more from the controlling session in O10, written blind by astra, and they cover the platformer. `genre` is `<genre>` or `<genre>.<mode>` from src/play/genre/contract.ts. `verb` is the goal-carrying verb, which wins over the others in the sentence. Metrics: README.md.

sentences.text: A penguin slides down an icy mountain, collects snowflakes and avoids rocks
A firefighter robot sprays water on burning trees and jumps over fallen logs
sentences.note: jumping over logs is an obstacle, not the goal

sentences.text: A tiny wizard rides a broom through a haunted castle and must light five candles before the ghosts catch him
A pirate ship dodges cannonballs while sailing between islands to find buried treasure
A cat collects glowing fish on a frozen lake while a polar bear chases it
A dog walks through a city
sentences.note: free movement through the city with checkpoints

sentences.text: Two knights duel in a castle

sealed.text: A rabbit hops across garden ledges to collect giant carrots.
A robot leaps between spooky rooftops to find its missing battery.
A turtle bounces across sleepy clouds to reach the moon.
